links.comparator_used: Conventional template assembly of discharge documents by the discharging clinician, with clinician validation in both arms
links.outcome: Record-concordant family understanding at follow-up (primary outcome); seriously consequential discrepancies in physician-facing documents
links.effect: Primary outcome difference −0.01 (95% CI −0.12 to 0.10); 0/117 delivered physician-facing documents judged seriously consequential; family documents in the LLM arm used more common vocabulary
links.tradeoff: Clinicians edited 48 of 58 drafts; review removed 18 of 22 unsupported additions but only 6 of 22 incorrect abbreviation expansions, so some LLM-generated errors passed review.
links.quote: Family documents in the LLM-assisted arm used more common vocabulary, but record-concordant understanding at follow-up, the primary outcome, did not differ (difference −0.01; 95% CI −0.12 to 0.10).

design_hint: clinician review of LLM-drafted discharge documents (human oversight)
